title: Update the Pangle block list
content_data:
Use this endpoint to update the Pangle block list. ## Comparing v1.2 and v1.3 The following table outlines the differences between v1.2 and v1.3 endpoints. ```xtable |Changes{30%}|v1.2{35%}|v1.3{35%}| |---|---|---| |Endpoint path|/v1.2/pangle_block_list/update/|/v1.3/pangle_block_list/update/| |Request parameter data type |`advertiser_id`: number|`advertiser_id`: string| ``` ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/pangle_block_list/update/ **Method** POST **Header** ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738373164380162).| |Content-Type {Required}|string|Request message type
Allowed format: `"application/json"`.| ``` **Parameters** ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |advertiser_id {Required}|string| Advertiser ID. | |add_app_list |string[]| Apps to add in the block list. iTunes ID for iOS app and package name for Android apps. | |delete_app_list |string[]| Apps to delete in the block list. iTunes ID for iOS app and package name for Android apps. | |clear_old_app |boolean| Whether to clear the original App block list, default value: `False`. If `False`, the corresponding App will be deleted and added based on the original list; if `True`, the original list will be cleared and the corresponding App will be added. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl -H "Access-Token:xxx" -H "Content-Type:application/json" -X POST \ -d '{ "advertiser_id": "ADVERTISER_ID", "clear_old_app": "CLEAR_OLD_APP", "add_app_list": [ "ADD_APP_LIST" ], "delete_app_list": [ "DELETE_APP_LIST" ] }' \ https://ads.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/pangle_block_list/update/ (/code) ``` ## Response ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |code |number|Return code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message |string|Return messages. For details, see [Appendix-Return information](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |data |object|Returned data. | #|success_count|number|The number of apps that have been sucessfully added to the block list. The success count will not include deletion, regardless of whether the deletion is successful or not. | |request_id |string|The log id of a request, which uniquely identifies the request.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "message": "OK", "code": 0, "data": { "success_count": 2 }, "request_id": "2020082611320501023125009013028" } (/code); ```
